notes.title: 🔊 Introducing Voice Chat in the Lobby! 🎤
notes.content:
Get ready to level up your gaming experience with our latest update! Now, you can chat with your squad loud and clear before diving into the action. Say hello to real-time strategy discussions.

🎮 Why Voice Chat?

• Team Coordination: Plan your tactics like a pro.
• Instant Connections: Bond with your crew instantly.
• More Fun: Laugh, strategize, and dominate together.

🌟 Key Features:

• Crystal-clear voice quality.
• Voice-activated banter! (No buttons needed!)
• Perfect for pre-game hype.

👥 Connect with Friends and Foes:
Whether you're strategizing with friends or chatting with rivals, voice chat brings a new dimension to your gaming circle.

🔥 Join the Conversation!
Update now and get ready to amplify the fun. Let your voice be heard in the ultimate gaming lobby experience!

Ready to dive in? Update your game and start chatting today. Let the games—and conversations—begin! 🚀

notes.title: Dystrovia is Available !
notes.content:
Can you survive on Dystrovia

Explore the depths and misty streets of Dystrovia; this new map will take you into the midst of urban battles in the heart of a megalopolis that reeks of pollution and corruption. Immerse yourself in the dark atmosphere of Dark Alley, where grimy skyscrapers conceal secrets as twisted as the winding alleys.

Faulty neon lights flicker weakly, casting eerie shadows on graffiti-covered walls. The sizzling sounds of rats feasting on garbage echo through narrow alleys, and every street corner seems to harbor a potential threat. Once thriving shopping centers, now dilapidated buildings serve as hideouts for rival factions vying for power.

Urban combat in Dark Alley demands agility and tactical intelligence. Use the environment to your advantage, from the corners of the alleys to unstable balconies, to gain the upper hand against your enemies. Muffled footsteps and low murmurs of conspiracies give this urban environment a unique character, where survival depends as much on your ability to navigate the shadows as on your combat skills.

Confront rival gangs, corrupt mercenaries, and venal law enforcement in this sinister area of Dystrovia. Every street corner hides high stakes, hidden treasures, and deadly risks. Will you be able to unveil the mysteries lurking in the darkness of Dark Alley, or will you simply be engulfed by the dark secrets of this fallen metropolis?
